newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain studies cut in Telefonica's int'l tariffs.
newsitem.headline: Spain studies cut in Telefonica's int'l tariffs.

text.p: Spain's Development Ministry is studying a reduction in Telefonica's international phone tariffs but the cuts have not yet received formal authorisation, a spokesman said on Friday.
"As of December 20 Telefonica has asked for a reduction in international call fees. But it hasn't yet received authorisation" a spokesman said, commenting on a press report.
Spanish financial daily "Cinco Dias" wrote that the ministry had approved an 8.8 percent cut in Telefonica international tariffs, effective from today.
Since end-1995 Telefonica has cut its international rates by around 25 percent.
